paper.abstract_en: We construct quantum channels by averaging unitary shift conjugations with respect to $κ$-additive probability measures on measurable abelian groups. The channels act on the duals of operator algebras generated by shifts and bounded measurable multiplication operators. They preserve $κ$-additivity of quantum states and admit a weak-$*$ integral representation on this class. If the averaging measure vanishes on singletons, every output state is singular. In the appendix, we also establish the corresponding Fubini's theorem for $κ$-additive measures.
